articles.title: Smithsonian's Lonnie Bunch to Step Down After White House Clash Over History
articles.summary: Lonnie Bunch, head of the Smithsonian, is resigning after a year of tension with the White House, which accused museum leaders of being 'radical activists.' He leaves at year's end.

articles.title: Canada Strikes Back: New Tariffs Escalate Trade War with U.S.
articles.summary: Canada imposed tariffs up to 50% on $20 billion of U.S. goods, matching U.S. tariffs dollar-for-dollar. Former minister Chrystia Freeland says the U.S. is 'punching friends in the face.'

articles.title: Harry and Meghan 'Surprised' by King's Letter Reaffirming Non-Working Royal Status
articles.summary: A letter from King Charles clarifies that Harry and Meghan remain non-working royals. The couple, who just moved back to the UK, say they were surprised by the timing.
